# Keybindings

<!-- GENERATED by `pnpm ra docs` from mappings/luna.toml. Do not hand-edit. -->

Every combo this project binds, generated from `mappings/luna.toml`.

The two key columns are the same bits rendered per platform — REAPER stores
one modifier bitfield and only the *labels* differ (`+8` is Command on macOS
and Ctrl on Linux, `+16` is Option vs. Alt, `+32` is Control vs. Super).

Importing a key map overrides only the combos named here; REAPER's other
defaults stay put. Key map → Reset to factory defaults backs it all out.

## The 2D edit area

These build the area or act on it. Per [CONSTITUTION.md](CONSTITUTION.md)
Principle 1, an operation acts on the data within the area's bounds and
clip boundaries play no part in scoping it.

| macOS | Linux | LUNA name | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Cmd+X` | `Ctrl+X` | Cut | Edit: Cut items (acts on the area natively) |
| `X` | `X` | Cut (Commands Focus) | Edit: Cut items (acts on the area natively) |
| `Cmd+C` | `Ctrl+C` | Copy | split at the area edges → select what's inside → Edit: Copy items/tracks/envelope points (depending on focus) ignoring time selection |
| `C` | `C` | Copy (Commands Focus) | split at the area edges → select what's inside → Edit: Copy items/tracks/envelope points (depending on focus) ignoring time selection |
| `Backspace` | `Backspace` | Clear | Item: Remove items (acts on the area natively) |
| `Cmd+D` | `Ctrl+D` | Duplicate selection | split at the area edges → select what's inside → Item: Duplicate items |
| `Cmd+M` | `Ctrl+M` | Mute Selection | split at the area edges → select what's inside → Item properties: Toggle mute |
| `N` | `N` | Normalize Selection | split at the area edges → select what's inside → Item properties: Normalize items (to loudest item) to +0dB peak |
| `D` | `D` | Fade To Clip Start (Fade In) | select the area's items → Item: Fade items in to cursor |
| `G` | `G` | Fade To Clip Stop (Fade Out) | select the area's items → Item: Fade items out from cursor |
| `A` | `A` | Trim From Clip Start | select the area's items → Item edit: Trim left edge of item to edit cursor |
| `S` | `S` | Trim From Clip End | select the area's items → Item edit: Trim right edge of item to edit cursor |
| `Cmd+T` | `Ctrl+T` | Trim Clip to Selection | select the area's items → Item: Trim items to selected area |
| `Cmd+E` | `Ctrl+E` | Separate Selection | script: split at the area, else at the edit cursor |
| `B` | `B` | Separate Selection (Commands Focus) | script: split at the area, else at the edit cursor |
| `Opt+Shift+3` | `Alt+Shift+3` | Consolidate Selection | select the area's items → Item: Glue items, expanding to time selection if any |
| `Cmd+H` | `Ctrl+H` | Heal Separation | select the area's items → Item: Heal splits in items |
| `P` | `P` | Move Selection Up | Track: Go to previous track → repaint the area over the new track selection |
| `;` | `;` | Move Selection Down | Track: Go to next track → repaint the area over the new track selection |
| `Shift+P` | `Shift+P` | Extend Selection Up | Track: Go to previous track (leaving other tracks selected) → repaint the area over the new track selection |
| `Shift+;` | `Shift+;` | Extend Selection Down | Track: Go to next track (leaving other tracks selected) → repaint the area over the new track selection |
| `Shift+Tab` | `Shift+Tab` | Extend Selection To Next Transient | script: grow the 2D area via Item navigation: Move cursor to next transient in items |
| `Shift+]` | `Shift+]` | Extend Selection To Next Bar | script: grow the 2D area via Move edit cursor forward one measure |
| `Shift+Num2` | `Shift+Num2` | Extend Selection To Next Bar (numpad) | script: grow the 2D area via Move edit cursor forward one measure |
| `Shift+[` | `Shift+[` | Extend Selection To Previous Bar | script: grow the 2D area via Move edit cursor back one measure |
| `Shift+Num1` | `Shift+Num1` | Extend Selection To Previous Bar (numpad) | script: grow the 2D area via Move edit cursor back one measure |
| `Shift+'` | `Shift+'` | Extend Selection To Next Clip Edge | script: grow the 2D area via Item navigation: Move cursor right to nearest item edge |
| `Shift+L` | `Shift+L` | Extend Selection To Previous Clip Edge | script: grow the 2D area via Item navigation: Move cursor left to nearest item edge |
| `Opt+Shift+Tab` | `Alt+Shift+Tab` | Extend Selection To Previous Transient | script: grow the 2D area via Item navigation: Move cursor to previous transient in items |
| `Opt+Shift+L` | `Alt+Shift+L` | Extend Selection To Previous Transient (Linux-safe alias) | script: grow the 2D area via Item navigation: Move cursor to previous transient in items |
| `Opt+Control+Shift+'` | `Alt+Super+Shift+'` | Extend Selection To Next Marker | script: grow the 2D area via Markers: Go to next marker/project end |
| `Opt+Control+Shift+L` | `Alt+Super+Shift+L` | Extend Selection To Previous Marker | script: grow the 2D area via Markers: Go to previous marker/project start |
| `Shift+Return` | `Shift+Return` | Extend Selection To Session Start | script: grow the 2D area via Transport: Go to start of project |
| `Opt+Shift+Return` | `Alt+Shift+Return` | Extend Selection To Session End | script: grow the 2D area via Transport: Go to end of project |
